g.text: Consists of one platform landing zone and many application landing zones
Copilot Studio agents can be grounded on data
from Fabric. They can use Foundry models
Microsoft Copilot 365 grounded on data from
Fabric and Work IQ. M365 files can feed Fabric
You typically have one per Microsoft Entra tenant. It provides governance for all Azure workloads and centralized resources i
security, management, networking/connectivity, and identity (Active Directory dependent)
Azure databases can be mirrored to Fabric for AI and analytics.
Foundry workloads can be grounded on data from Fabric
Each workload has a single application landing zone. An application landing zone contains all the environments and resources
required to support that workload, such as development, test, and production. Each environment consists of one or more Azure
subscriptions used is determined by workload requirements, team boundaries, or Azure subscription limits.
